text:
```yaml
name: Validate PR title

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  validate-pr-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check PR title
        uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v6
        with:
          types: feat,fix,chore
          subjectPattern: '^[a-z].*'
```
